reviews.title: Totally Unimpressed
reviews.text:
This site is pretty much a trap. Users are basically charged a fee to purchase credits that are used to communicate with other users for each form of communication (txt message, email, voice mail, etc). This means that each time you send a txt, email etc, you are charged. 
Ah, but it gets better. 
This site is full of matches whose full-time job is to encourage/ entice you into conversations. 
They are pretty easy to spot (orange flame top left-hand corner of their photo) and are listed as “Free Users”; they will also have some super professional photos / videos. Per my experience, they never sleep, no matter the time difference which leads me to believe that some are perhaps hanging in cyber cafe’s / AI.😉 
It’s kinda sad as this could be a pretty good site but I feel that it’s pretty much set up to drain your wallet. Hope this helps!

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
This app feels like a scam. Several profiles seem fake, and the conversations feel like they could be AI-generated. I couldn’t tell whether I was talking to real people.

They make you pay to chat, which feels misleading when the profiles don’t seem genuine. Based on my experience, I wouldn’t recommend downloading this app or spending money on it.

reviews.title: App feels like a scam
reviews.text:
The app uses credits for a pay as you use instead of charging a flat rate subscription for unlimited use.

As soon as you join you get spammed with messages from model looking women. Most are free users so they can talk forever while you have to pay for credits. Most of these “people” that spam you with messages are probably contractors or AI whose only purpose is to drain your credits so you buy more. 

Then when you do meet someone real the app has measures in place to block every attempt to move the conversation off platform like they block your phone number for example anywhere you type it. 

All in all this just feels really scammy so I would recommend an app like Tinder or bumble heck even Facebook dating was a much better experience over this app.
